GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Began well. Rolled fwd & raced 2nd on rail (1.5L from lead) until Two Wide @ 700m. Stayed 2nd Two Wide midrace & held together 3 Wide (1L from lead) on ome turn. Pressured Four Wide & challenged leader @ 300m. Weakened 3 Wide in last 200m. # On-pace/weakened.
Jumped Ok Settled Down 4th 2 lengths. hooked 3 Wide turn 1 length. weakened # Every Chance
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began only fairly. Raced keenly for a short distance passing the 700m. Passing the 300m laid in and had to be restrained from heels.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok held rail half off, under pressure turn and dropped out # poor/amiss?
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rider reported mount raced very greenly and gave limited response when asked for an effort in straight, added would derive benefit from experience. A post-race vet exam revealed a poor post-race recovery. Tnr was told a vet clearance would be required prior to next race/trial. Vet clearance since received.
